name: U.S. DOT Open Data (data.transportation.gov, Socrata SODA)
summary: Free SODA REST API over the Department of Transportation's open data portal: NHTSA recalls, FMCSA motor carrier census, border crossings, transit ridership, crash files and more.
description: data.transportation.gov is a Socrata portal run by the U.S. DOT and its operating administrations (NHTSA, FMCSA, BTS, FTA, FHWA). Each dataset is queryable at /resource/{4x4-id}.json with SoQL. Several popular data.gov entries live here, for example Recalls Data (6axg-epim), Company Census File, Motor Carrier Registrations, Border Crossing Entry Data, Crash File, State, County and City FIPS Reference Table and Complete Monthly Ridership.

auth.notes: Works without credentials; an optional free Socrata app token gives a per-application throttling pool instead of the shared per-IP pool.

rate_limit.summary: No numeric limit documented. Without an app token requests share a per-IP pool and can be throttled with HTTP 429.

endpoints.summary: Discovery API: search datasets on the portal
Dataset metadata: columns, license, update time

license.name: Public Domain U.S. Government (as stated in the Recalls Data dataset metadata; other datasets may differ)

agent_notes: Find ids via /api/catalog/v1?domains=data.transportation.gov&q=<topic>. Values are strings; cast in SoQL. The X-SODA2-Fields header lists columns. For recalls by vehicle, the NHTSA API (see nhtsa-vehicle-apis) is more convenient.
caveats: Numeric columns are returned as JSON strings.

In the research sandbox the host's certificate chain was not trusted, so curl needed -k; the API itself answered 200 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *. Re-verify on a machine with a current CA store.

The Discovery API with domains=data.transportation.gov returned resultSetSize 1 in one test, so do not rely on it to count datasets; search without the domain filter and check each result's domain instead.
The www.transportation.gov site answered 403 to curl; only the data portal was tested.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without an app token using curl -k because of the sandbox trust store.
